meta.message: A fast one-shot axe chop: a thick dark-red crescent with a bone-white core sweeps from upper left to lower right over about 8 frames at 96x96, then a short blood spray bursts off the end of the swing. It is side-on with no ground ellipse or top-down shading, and the canvas edges are clear. The last frame is nearly empty, so trim it if your game needs a tighter clip; the blood count and speed sliders control the spray.
